name: The Shieldsmith
summary: In Stormwind, Yorus Barleybrew sends warriors back after a harrowing trial in the Redridge Mountains. He gives them a cask of Barleybrew Scalder to take to Furen Longbeard, who will fashion a stout shield.

sections.title: A Promise Kept
sections.body: After you prove your mettle against the gnolls and perils of the Rethban Gauntlet, Yorus Barleybrew honors his bargain. The promised reward cannot be hammered out in Lakeshire, so he directs promising fighters back to Stormwind City. A dwarven armorer there stands ready to repay a personal debt.

sections.title: Barleybrew's Finest
sections.body: Yorus gives you a heavy cask of Barleybrew Scalder instead of a letter of credit. Take it to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind's Dwarven District, where soot and hammer-clatter fill the air. The seasoned smith recognizes the name behind the delivery and lends his craft to a warrior seeking a stout shield.

faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorer and shieldsmith stationed in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Alliance warriors know his skill, and he crafts specialized defensive gear for martial veterans who earn his respect.

faq.q: Why does Yorus send you to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yorus Barleybrew sends you to Stormwind because he promised a martial shield but lacks the specialized smithing skills to forge one himself. His friend Furen Longbeard owes him a significant favor.

Barleybrew Scalder is an exceptionally potent dwarven drink made by the Barleybrew family. Yorus sends a fresh cask to Furen Longbeard to slake the smith's thirst and grease the wheels of their arrangement.

faq.q: Where can Furen Longbeard be found?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard tends his forge in the heart of Stormwind City's Dwarven District, among the soot, anvils, and workshops of dwarven crafters.

faq.q: What happens after giving Furen the cask?
faq.answer: The cask confirms that Yorus sent you. Furen acknowledges his debt and immediately offers to construct defensive armor suited to seasoned battle, beginning the path to fire-hardened gear.

faq.q: Why is this errand important for Alliance warriors?
faq.answer: This delivery introduces an Alliance warrior to one of the kingdom's most capable armorers. It opens the way to tailored martial gear and further instruction in defensive warfare.

angles.text: As a warrior, you carry the grit of Redridge to Stormwind and prove your right to bear a shield forged by a legendary dwarven armorer.
As a dwarf, you know that trading a cask of fine Barleybrew ale for forged iron in Stormwind's Dwarven District is familiar business.
As a blacksmith, you meet Furen Longbeard, whose specialized defensive armor work is celebrated throughout the Alliance.
